name: std::fetestexcept
intro: Determines which of the specified subset of the floating point exceptions are currently set. The argument excepts is a bitwise OR of the floating point exception macros.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
excepts

 -

  bitmask listing the exception flags to test

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Bitwise OR of the floating-point exception macros that are both included in excepts and correspond to floating-point exceptions currently set.

examples.output:
1.0/0.0 = inf
division by zero reported
1.0/10 = 0.1
inexact result reported
sqrt(-1) = -nan
invalid result reported

summary: Determines which of the specified subset of the floating point exceptions are currently set. The argument excepts is a bitwise OR of the floating point exception macros.
